title: Expose a compact product summary in initial HTML
rationale: The site already has strong visible product messaging and an llms.txt file, but crawlers that do not execute JavaScript see almost none of that context.

suggested_action.summary: Place a concise server-rendered summary of Linkit's audience, category, and flagship features in the page source.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Include a short semantic paragraph and a small list of core features in the initial HTML, then hydrate the richer interactive layout around it.

title: Add a first-party changelog and FAQ knowledge layer
rationale: The site has Releases and support-oriented product claims in llms.txt; turning common questions into crawlable FAQ content would improve answerability for feature, pricing, and setup queries.

suggested_action.summary: Publish crawlable FAQs for pricing, setup, privacy, and feature boundaries, with FAQPage markup where eligible.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Link the FAQ and dated release entries from the homepage, keep answers in HTML, and add valid FAQPage or Article structured data only where the visible content qualifies.
